name: Forward a Message
description: Forwards messages of any kind. [See the docs](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#forwardmessage) for more information

configurable_props.name: chatId
configurable_props.label: Chat ID
configurable_props.description: Enter the unique identifier for the target chat (e.g. `1035597319`) or username of the target public chat (in the format `@channelusername` or `@supergroupusername`). For example, if the group's public link is `t.me/mygroup`, the username is `@mygroup`.

configurable_props.name: fromChatId
configurable_props.label: From Chat ID
configurable_props.description: Enter the unique identifier for the chat where the original message was sent (or channel username in the format `@channelusername`).

configurable_props.name: disable_notification
configurable_props.label: Disable Notifications
configurable_props.description: Choose if to send the message silently. iOS users will not receive a notification, Android users will receive a notification with no sound.
